_comment: Pinned row counts for post-2018 HMDA bronze files and silver partitions, keyed dataset -> activity year -> file_type (a=three-year, b=one-year, c=snapshot, e=MLAR). Enforced at build time by check_expected_row_count (import_bronze/import_silver) and re-verified against the live parquet footers by tests/test_hmda/test_row_count_guard.py. Pinned 2026-08-31 from bronze parquet footers, cross-checked row-exact against an independent read of the raw archives. Bronze and silver carry identical counts for these datasets (no row drops between layers). Update an entry only deliberately - when the CFPB republishes a file and the new count has been verified against the raw archive; a SHORT count always means a truncated write.
